curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What drives an ordinary man to pose as an acclaimed film director, and what happens when the actual victims agree to play themselves on screen?
curatedMovie.description: After a young man in Tehran is arrested for impersonating renowned filmmaker Mohsen Makhmalbaf, Abbas Kiarostami brings the real participants together to reenact and examine the fraud.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Slow, contemplative, and emotionally grounded docufiction suited for immersive solo viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Kiarostami blends fiction and documentary seamlessly, turning a real courtroom case into a thoughtful, deeply human meditation on cinema and identity.
